class.name: ConstraintGraphModifier3D
class.brief_description: Evaluates an ordered, data-driven list of rig constraints.
class.description: [ConstraintGraphModifier3D] evaluates [member constraints] from top to bottom on the skeleton pose. Every constraint is a dictionary with a [code]type[/code], optional [code]enabled[/code] (default [code]true[/code]) and [code]weight[/code] (default [code]1.0[/code]): - [code]two_bone[/code]: [code]root[/code], [code]mid[/code], [code]tip[/code], [code]target[/code], optional [code]pole[/code]. - [code]fabrik_chain[/code]: [code]bones[/code] (root first), [code]target[/code], optional [code]iterations[/code]. - [code]aim[/code]: [code]bone[/code], [code]target[/code], optional [code]forward[/code] (default [code]Vector3.FORWARD[/code]) and [code]max_angle[/code] (radians). - [code]copy_rotation[/code]: [code]src[/code], [code]dst[/code], optional [code]offset[/code] ([Quaternion] or [code][x, y, z, w][/code]). - [code]limit_rotation[/code]: [code]bone[/code], optional [code]min_deg[/code] and [code]max_deg[/code] ([Vector3] or [code][x, y, z][/code]). Bones can be given by name or by index. Targets can be a [Vector3] in skeleton space, an array [code][x, y, z][/code], a [NodePath] or [code]{"node": path}[/code] to a [Node3D], or [code]{"bone": name_or_index}[/code]. A constraint whose target node is missing is skipped. The evaluation itself is available offline through [method evaluate_pose], which works on a pose dictionary ([code]positions[/code] and [code]rotations[/code]).

method.name: add_constraint
method.description: Appends a constraint and returns its index.

method.name: from_json
method.description: Loads constraints from JSON text written by [method to_json]. Returns [code]false[/code] on invalid input.

method.name: get_last_log
method.description: Returns the log of the last evaluation: dictionaries with [code]index[/code], [code]type[/code] and [code]applied[/code].

method.name: move_constraint
method.description: Moves a constraint to another position in the evaluation order.

method.name: evaluate_pose
method.description: Evaluates [param constraints] on a pose and returns a pose with [code]positions[/code], [code]rotations[/code] and a [code]log[/code] array.

method.name: make_pose
method.description: Creates a pose dictionary. Missing rotations are filled with identity.
